name: Дом снаружи
prompt: A small cozy two-story storybook cottage belonging to two best friends. Cream-colored exterior walls, muted terracotta roof, four simple windows (two upstairs, two downstairs), small wooden front door, tiny front porch, one flower pot, small mailbox, short garden fence and one tree beside the house. Warm welcoming atmosphere. Traditional hand-drawn children's illustration, uneven black marker outlines, warm textured paper, pastel colored pencil shading. Keep the exact same architecture, window positions, roof shape, entrance, tree and proportions in every generation.
